name: Feywood Ranger's Studded Leather
description: Studded leather produced to elven ranger specification — sanctioned hides (silverbough hart, Feywoodhorn stag, rootback elk) tanned with elven processes, reinforced with small elven-forged studs set flush to reduce catch-snag on brush and deadfall. Lighter than realm studded leather of equivalent protection and noticeably quieter in motion.
narrative_effects: Provides light-armor protection with the quieter motion elven field operation demands.
Studs are placed for flexibility rather than visual bulk; rangers and ranger-adjacent roles prefer this pattern.
House identifiers may be subtly worked into the stud pattern, readable to trained elven observers but not obvious to outsiders.
